headline.purpose: Today's read — the only full sentence set large.

figure.purpose: Measured values, tabular. Placeholders drop to label scale.

title.purpose: Section headings above a full-strength rule.

label.purpose: Field names and section markers. Defined once as label-caps.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: True overlays only — the drawer and the confirm dialog. Nothing in the document flow carries a shadow.

motion.name: dur-route
motion.purpose: Route cross-fade. The only entrance on a page load.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: useReducedMotion() is read in the shell and every duration collapses. Non-negotiable on a tool opened many times a day.

narrative.overview:
A daily brief, not a dashboard. The page opens with the finding — what is true today and what to do about it — and puts the numbers underneath as support. The console it replaced reported figures and left the interpretation to the reader, which is why the person it was built for stopped opening it.

Two refusals define the system. The first is the card: nothing floats, nothing is enclosed in a rounded shadowed box. Structure comes from one-pixel rules, bordered bands, and rows. The second is the dark chrome panel — a filled dark sidebar beside a light page is the single most reliable way a console announces that it could belong to any product.

The third rule is not visual at all, and it outranks both. Every sentence on this surface is derived from a measurement, and no measurement is stated more confidently than its sample allows. Unknown is its own state everywhere — never rendered as zero, never as 'healthy', never as an em-dash beside a green chip.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground (#F7F5EF), never white, never dark
Archivo throughout, one family, weight carrying hierarchy
One accent, moss, meaning 'the system is working' — never a data colour
One attention tone, marking a task rather than a failure
Rules and rows instead of cards; shadows only on true overlays
Near-square corners (2-3px), so nothing reads as a widget
Tabular figures by default, set at the base layer

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Moss means 'working'. It is never a series colour, a chart line, or a decorative fill. An accent that means two things means nothing.

rules.name: The Attention-Not-Alarm Rule
rules.body: #A8412B marks a task, not a failure. Nothing here should make a person feel caught out; the product's voice forbids it for followers and the same restraint applies to its operator.

rules.name: The Ground Truth Rule
rules.body: Every colour was measured against #F7F5EF. A previous palette was measured against #0a0a0a and a third against #F7F4EE; none survived the move. If the ground changes again, every value is void until re-measured.

rules.name: The Tabular Default Rule
rules.body: Figures are tabular at the base layer, not per component. Numbers here are compared down columns, and a new component must not be able to ship proportional figures by omission.

rules.name: The Placeholder Is Not A Figure Rule
rules.body: An em-dash standing in for a missing number is set at label scale, not figure scale. At figure size it is a 60px hole where a value should be.

rules.name: The Coarse Pointer Rule
rules.body: Every interactive element carries a 44px minimum target under @media (pointer: coarse), and only under it. A mouse keeps the density and a thumb gets the target.

rules.name: The Wayfinding Rule
rules.body: Every screen answers four questions: where am I, where can I go, what is here, and how do I leave.

rules.name: The Proximity Rule
rules.body: A control sits beside the thing it changes.

rules.name: The Rules-Not-Boxes Rule
rules.body: If two regions need separating, the answer is a 1px rule and more space. Never a radius, never a fill, never a shadow. A card in the document flow is this system's first and most likely regression.

dos: Do separate with a 1px rule and more space.
Do keep moss for 'working' and nothing else.
Do carry counts alongside every rate, and render counts instead of a rate when the sample is thin.
Do give loading, failed and empty three distinct treatments. A failed request must never render as an empty account.
Do derive every sentence from a measurement; if it cannot be derived, do not print it.
Do give every interactive element a 44px target under a coarse pointer, and press feedback on pointer-down.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion on every entrance and transition.
Do load the typeface, and check it in the built output.
Do re-measure every colour if the ground ever changes.
donts: Don't put content in a card. No filled, bordered, rounded, shadowed container in the document flow — this is the system's first rule.
Don't add a shadow to anything that is not a true overlay.
Don't introduce a dark chrome panel, least of all the rail.
Don't use moss, or any country colour, as a general-purpose accent.
Don't state a percentage without a usable baseline, or above a withheld rate.
Don't show a green status beside a value you do not have.
Don't add a second typeface, or reach past weight 500 for emphasis.
Don't write an eyebrow above a heading, or number sections when the order carries no information.
Don't rely on hover for anything a phone user needs.
